item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.2 adds downstream pipeline visibility and refines the menu bar indicator.
- The indicator tooltip uses the same time-window label as Preferences, for example “within the last 2 hours”, without “newest first”. - Filled and outlined indicator circles use the same 5-point outer silhouette. - Trigger jobs now expose downstream pipelines after the supplied arrow icon. Click a downstream circle to inspect its jobs or open its pipeline in GitLab. - Nested and cross-project downstream jobs contribute to overall job-completion progress. Trigger proxies are replaced by their downstream jobs, and shared pipelines are counted once. The parent’s status remains the status reported by GitLab. - Unavailable or truncated downstream details are identified explicitly rather than displaying misleading complete progress. Traversal is bounded to 100 downstream pipelines and 10 levels per displayed root.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.1 corrects running icons and adds a configurable recent-pipeline window for the menu bar indicator.
- Running stage and job circles use the blue #1F75CB fill and clock glyph with the pale #CCE3FA stroke. The pipeline Status column continues to show overall job-completion progress. - Neutral circles have transparent interiors. Created jobs use the neutral ring with a small gray center dot instead of next-job arrows. - Indicator dots represent the three newest pipelines created within the selected time window, newest first. The default window is 120 minutes, configurable under Preferences from 15 minutes to 24 hours. - Missing, canceled, and pending slots use empty white outlines. Recent completed pipelines keep their status color until they age out, even when none are running. - The running-pipeline total continues to cover all watched projects independently of the indicator window. No number is shown when the count is zero.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.0 adds a four-tab settings window, per-event notification controls, launch at login, signed update checks, and new application branding.
- Project labels now show only the immediate group and project slug. - OAuth opens in the system default browser; connected accounts show Disconnect instead of another sign-in button. - Notifications can be selected for started, passed, warning, failed, canceled, and skipped pipelines. - Preferences include Open at login and Automatically update. The right-click menu includes event choices and Check for Updates. - When no pipelines are running, the indicator shows three empty circles without a number.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening the downloaded build.
The first installation of this updater-enabled version is manual for earlier local builds. Future releases can be discovered from Check for Updates or through the optional automatic update setting.
